name: Morbydrip the Crewal Whale
printed_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; place it and this card face-up in their owners' Spell & Trap Zones as Continuous Traps in their same columns. (If the Zones are occupied, destroy the occupying card.) While this card is a Continuous Trap, if an opponent monster is Special Summoned in this card's column: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do during the End Phase of this turn banish all Monster Cards in the Spell & Trap Zones, except "Morbydrip The Crewal Whale". You can only use this effect of "Morbydrip The Crewal Whale" once per turn. You can only control 1 "Morbydrip The Crewal Whale".
